title: A DEAD PEDDLER LEAVES HIS REMAINS, NOT A BOX
why: His note: it would be cool if it showed wreckage instead, same for other enemy deaths. A dead Peddler left the purple cache box. The cache is now tagged and drawn as the trader fallen in his duster with the wide hat knocked off, his pack frame and bedroll toppled beside him, the stock spilled, the lantern knocked out. Looting is unchanged.
now: A dead Peddler leaves his pack and spilled stock.
